name: lemma-submission-videos
description: The Lemma pitch and demo videos, as one Remotion project. Not an npm workspace of the monorepo.

scripts.prepare:pitch: node scripts/timeline.mjs pitch && node scripts/music.mjs pitch
scripts.prepare:demo: node scripts/timeline.mjs demo && node scripts/music.mjs demo
scripts.render:pitch: npm run prepare:pitch && remotion render src/index.ts Pitch out/lemma-pitch-music-only.mp4
scripts.render:pitch-guide: npm run prepare:pitch && remotion render src/index.ts PitchGuide out/lemma-pitch-guide.mp4
scripts.render:demo: npm run prepare:demo && remotion render src/index.ts Demo out/lemma-demo-music-only.mp4
scripts.render:demo-guide: npm run prepare:demo && remotion render src/index.ts DemoGuide out/lemma-demo-guide.mp4
